scope: Single native SEE shared-DMA input and original QDI/HRP transport.
source_owner: xr-device-io owns one SDSP session, the hardware lock, two real4096-byte DMA allocations and sns_low_lat_stream channels.

steps: Producer initializes the two real channels without starting sensor streams.
Producer sends Buffers with SCM_RIGHTS references to the original DMA allocations. No memfd or copied104-byte input is substituted.
Head imports both fds into its borrowed CDSP session and registers original descriptors before QVR start.
Head sends Start; producer configures both SEE channels with period1250us, flags2 and original SUIDs.
Producer sends unchanged104-byte sample events and measured clock tuples. Native CDSP QDI receives the firmware notification independently.
Head joins its AP metadata/pose reader, sends Stop and drains queued metadata until Stopped. Producer stops both channels, joins waiters and deinitializes before Stopped.
Head stops/deinitializes/closes QVR and releases borrowed CDSP mappings before closing imported fd references. Failed teardown retains affected mappings until owning FastRPC process exit.

native_rings.native_interpretation: The native DSP branch reads allocation base as Android direct-report104-byte records,39 complete records per4096 bytes; descriptor element64/count8 are original service metadata, not a repacking instruction.

record.counter: Nonzero producer counter; UINT32_MAX wraps to1. AP metadata preserves its real value.
record.axes: Original Android portrait, rad/s and m/s2; no AP bias subtraction or raw-gyro integration.

firmware_flags.bit2: is_calibrated; clear for chosen uncalibrated types
firmware_flags.bit0: Not consumed by selected resident sns_llcm_config; do not import another SDK interrupt enum.
firmware_flags.notify_mode: Original sns_llcm registry qti_vr_mode=1 enables native interrupt attach/send independently of these flags.

time.native_event_and_pose: QTimer nanoseconds in original VR mode. SLPI converts19.2MHz ticks using ticks*625/12; qc_vr_mode bypasses timestamp_offset addition.
time.pose_epoch_proof: Native receiver copies event+16 into paired IMU input; calibration helper copies timestamps unchanged; tracker helper passes original gyro timestamp to pose transform, which stores it unchanged at pose+32.
time.qtimer_rpc: QVR method9 returns raw ticks; it is not a pose timestamp and is not used as a substitute for a sample epoch.
time.wire: AP matches native pose timestamp to a real gyro104 event and applies that event measured QTimer-to-BOOTTIME tuple once. Both real IMU metadata times use the same tuple; transport separately measures BOOTTIME-to-MONOTONIC.
time.camera: QCFT raw frame-associated sof_qtimer ticks use the same625/12 conversion as original native sensor timestamps, followed by original exposure/19335ns line/half-exposure arithmetic. BOOTTIME remains AP grouping/export metadata only.
time.forbidden: Arrival/receipt time is never used as a gyro, accel, camera or pose sample timestamp.
time.clock_mapping: Measured bracket/uncertainty is preserved; no1s event age,1ms bracket,500us bound or1s source-progress watchdog rejects otherwise consistent input. Actual hardware/RPC errors and explicit lifecycle events still terminate.

publication.hrp_owner: Original native adsp_imu/QDI thread; camera caller does not feed IMU or synthesize prediction.
publication.ap_reader: Independent thread continuously drains SEE metadata and reads latest published OEM pose slot with DMA CPU sync and finite consistency-copy checks. No HRP or motion filter runs on AP.
publication.association: Retain up to original80 published output slots pending exact gyro-epoch association; input caches retain39 real samples per channel. Publish only new, strictly increasing, matched native pose epochs. Missing metadata or unchanged output is diagnostic, not an IMU-only replacement pose.
publication.accel_metadata: Choose nearest real accel event from same native source cache; may be after gyro. This diagnostic field is not proof of the exact sample chosen inside DSP at update time.
publication.consistency_limit: The original80-slot output index wraps and has no generation. Index/copy equality detects observed changes but cannot prove an atomic snapshot across arbitrary producer scheduling.
publication.not_ready: No pose is published until a nonzero real OEM epoch is associated. Poor OEM quality/state remains original data for downstream field validity.
publication.freshness: No time-based takeover is added. If native HRP stops while SEE remains alive, no new epoch is advertised; downstream preserves original cached-slot state. A cached TRACKING bit does not establish a fresh measurement. Pose update counts and last native epoch are explicit diagnostics; actual source error/EOF/Stop ends the stream.

controller_hand_export.source: Unique NativeHistoryQuery callback reads original complete80-slot Ring1; no AP pose cache or pose() feed remains.
controller_hand_export.query: Nonzero QCFT sof_qtimer converted by625/12 and original exposure-start correction; choose minimum absolute record+32 distance over physical slots0..79, strict< preserves first physical slot on ties. Future records are allowed; no interpolation/extrapolation/time-distance limit.
controller_hand_export.clock: Preserve original selected sample QTimer ns. Checked signed mapping uses this same frame sample_qtimer/sample_boottime tuple. Query time and selected sample time remain distinct; no arrival timestamp is substituted.
controller_hand_export.representation: Callback returns raw q/p/time. Exporter only checks finite position and finite nonzero quaternion and mathematically normalizes the SDK-bound local quaternion copy. No norm tolerance, quality/state or0.2 gate. Native DSP record and main240-byte raw pose are untouched.
controller_hand_export.synchronization: Same Ring read mutex serializes DMA CPU-access intervals for stream/latest and historical callback. Full80-slot immutable copy plus selected-record/index observation detects interference, with finite3 attempts. No generation/seqlock or atomic-snapshot guarantee.
controller_hand_export.lifetime: Bind both exporter callbacks before visual capture starts. Finish/join capture and finish main hand-frame calls, then clear callbacks before CDSP/ring teardown.
controller_hand_export.validation: Strict ARM64 syntax, local control regression and immutable recorded raw-ring replay only; live concurrent DMA/history and SDK behavior require target verification.
